text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: DIVPANN/LND/ACBOA/1/7/21. Ministry of Lands Ref No.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/236. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude for public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: All that allotment of land in total extent of about 2.3340 ha., depicted in sheet No. 01, Block No. 02, Lot No. 307 in the plan No. Cad. Map 420593 and dated 17.01.2013, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village of Badabedda, in Medapattu West Korale, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Pannala in Kurunegala District, North Western Province and bounded as follows.

Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Kandetiya; Description of the Land: Estate; Claimant: Jude Deepal Iranga Peiris; Extent: 2.3340 Hectare. All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/servitude hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me on 30th April, 2025 at 10.30 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Pannala. And further, you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 23rd April, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. R. M. S. Wංർ඄උൺආൺඋൺඍඁඇൾ Bൺඇൽൺඋൺ, Divisional Secretary, Pannala. Divisional Secretariat, Pannala. 05th March, 2025 EOG 03 - 0161.
